messages:
Maya: Quick run-through: I pushed an updated onprem preflight flow prototype to Figma. Main things I want feedback on: the network step error states, copy for the port check, and how we surface remediation hints inline. Screenshot: https://fig.ma/redwood/UX-Lab-123 :eyes:
Samir: looked good — 2 quick notes: the ‘port open’ vs ‘port listening’ phrasing confused me. Can we be explicit: 'service reachable on port 443' or 'TCP connect succeeded'?
Eli: +1 on being explicit. For non-technical customers, maybe show both: headline plain English + small monospace detail. e.g.

Maya: good idea. mock: "Service reachable on port 443 — (TCP connect OK)"
Frank: UX nit: error color contrast is low on the inline chip — fails 3:1. Need 4.5:1. Also the red/green pair is relying on color alone. Add icons and pattern?
A11yBot: Accessibility reminder — live updates to the preflight status must be announced to screen readers. Use aria-live="polite" for incremental checks and provide a summary region with role="status" after the step completes.
Eli: For the summary: please include an at-a-glance status line that reads e.g. "Network checks: 3 passed, 1 failed" and link to actionable help. That helps keyboard/sr users.
Samir: Inline remediation suggestions should be copy-first (one-liner), then a collapsible troubleshooting panel for advanced steps. Example one-liner: "Firewall is blocking outbound connections to s3.redwood.ai — allow outbound TCP 443 to s3.redwood.ai"
Maya: Agree. Also thinking of adding a copy button next to the CLI snippet. Proposed snippet:

```bash
# run from the host in the customer network
curl -v https://s3.redwood.ai/health || echo "connect failed"
```

Maya: Copy button should have aria-label "Copy network test command"
Frank: We should also make the help link contextual: if DNS fails show a KB about DNS and include the exact hostname that failed. If TCP fails show ports + suggested local command.
Samir: Small copy tweak: replace "Retry preflight" with "Re-run checks" — less intimidating and clearer.
Eli: On the modal focus behavior — when the preflight modal opens, focus should land on the first interactive check, not the close button. Also trap focus while it's open.
A11yBot: Alert — to meet screen reader expectations include a keyboard shortcut hint and ensure the progress spinner has aria-hidden=true and is announced via the status region.
Maya: UX question: do we want auto-polling of checks every 10s, or explicit re-run? Auto looks friendlier but can be noisy for screenreader users. Thoughts?
Samir: Prefer explicit re-run for now. We can add an opt-in "auto watch" toggle — defaults off.
Frank: Another microcopy: replace "Host is online" with "Host responds to TCP on port X". Full sentence explains the check.
Eli: Also add a machine-readable failure code in the UI dataset so ops can map to KB articles: e.g., network.DNS_FAILURE, network.TCP_REFUSED. Show the code in the collapsed details only.
Maya: UX mock update: added an inline hint pill that says "what this means" linking to expanded help. Also added a small toast that appears when re-run completes: "Checks complete — 3 passed, 1 failed". Is toast OK accessibility-wise?
A11yBot: Toasts are fine if they are non-modal and they also update the status region. Don't auto-dismiss too quickly (use at least 5s) and ensure keyboard users can dismiss.
OpsBot: deploy-bot:preflight-run started for maya/design-lab at 1767777777
Samir: tiny: change stepper label from "Network" to "Network (required)" — makes it obvious during email handoffs.
Maya: thanks all — I'll update the Figma and doc and drop a new screenshot here. Next actions: Frank to propose accessible color tokens, Eli to draft the status summary copy, Samir to update the CTA wording, I'll add copy button + aria labels.
Frank: on it, will post contrast tokens by EOD. :thumbsup:
Eli: drafting copy now, will ping when done.
Maya: closing loop — will update thread when Figma is pushed. Thanks!
